description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

AMEWAS provides engineering, testing, and evaluation support for U.S. Navy weapons systems. The Junior Software Developer supports development, integration, documentation, and testing of safety-critical Guardian and UAV Detect and Avoid software systems.
Junior Software Developer supporting safety-critical Guardian and UAV Detect-and-Avoid software design, development, testing, documentation, and C++ code review

Responsibilities:
• Provides safety critical engineering services for the Atlantic Test Range Guardian systems
• Supports the design, development, documentation, and testing of all components that make up the Guardian System software suite and the UAV Detect and Avoid System
• Develops software for a safety critical UAV Detect and Avoid system
• Documents software to DO-278 standards
• Supports software development, software integration, and customer training/demonstrations
• Demonstrates knowledge of standard programming algorithms, design patterns, and object-oriented software design
• Evaluates and reviews C++ language code

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering from an ABET accredited college
• 1 year of experience working as a Software Developer
• Experience with scripting and programming in C++ or other object-oriented programming languages (Java and/or Python)
• Experience with Git or equivalent configuration management tools
• Experience with QT
• The ability to obtain and maintain the DoD security clearance eligibility and/or additional security access requirements necessary to perform the duties of the position, as required by the contract
• U.S. Citizenship is required for all clearances
• Candidates must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis
• AMEWAS is unable to provide employment-based visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future
• Candidates must demonstrate a customer-focused mindset, professionalism, and discretion, while working collaboratively with management and teams to meet objectives
• Candidates should be hard-working individuals with strong attention to detail and the ability to foster a positive, team-oriented culture

Preferred:
• Experience with Jira
• Experience with Linux
• Experience RHEL
• Experience with network programming
